name: ROS1 Pick-Place Pipeline Translation to ROS2
description: Translate a ROS1 pick-and-place pipeline using MoveIt into ROS2 code while preserving key semantics such as node initialization, MoveGroupInterface, gripper operations, pick/place pipeline, and collision objects.

oracle_testcases.description: Check that a ROS2 node is initialized and spinning asynchronously
Verify MoveGroupInterface is created for panda_arm
Ensure openGripper is called for pre_grasp_posture
Ensure closedGripper is called for grasp_posture
Ensure openGripper is called after place() for post_place_posture
Check that pick and place pipeline is called with collision objects

notes: This metadata file defines the key semantics and expected outcomes for benchmarking LLM ROS1->ROS2 translation for pick-place tasks.
